description: This file defines a Python class '_PROXY_VirtualKeyModelMaxBudgetLimiter' that handles budget management for virtual API keys and models in a proxy setting. It includes methods for checking model budgets, retrieving spend data, and logging events related to budget usage, integrating with caching and external logging mechanisms.
